in_sanskrit.name: रुपेश्कुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: रूप (form, appearance) + ईश् (God) + कुमार (younger brother of a god)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the form of a god and is the younger brother of a god.

in_hindi.name: रुपेश्कुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has the form of a god and is a god himself in the form of a younger brother.

in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the form of a god and is the younger brother of a god.

in_marathi.name: Rupeshkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupeshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupa means wealth or form and Es means God. So, Rupeshkumar means a wealthy God or the one who possesses form of wealth.

in_bengali.name: Rupeshkumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wealthy God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rupeshkumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rupa means wealth or form and Es means God. So, Rupeshkumar means a wealthy God or the one who possesses form of wealth.
